verdict.rationale: Well-documented Catalog MCP servers (Global and Storefront) expose machine-readable offers via search_catalog/get_product with price (minor units), availability signals, variants, and continue_url/checkout links, and Cart/Checkout MCP tools return structured totals and checkout continuation URLs — all schema-driven and introspectable (--input-schema). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration beyond first-party docs, and no public OpenAPI/schema file was found via probe (404s).
